legend: The Mad Gasser of Mattoon (Illinois, USA, September 1944)
lines: Night after night, people reported a sweet, strange smell drifting through their windows.
Some said they felt weak, and that a tall figure in dark clothes stood outside.
The newspapers soon called him the Mad Gasser.
Neighbours patrolled the streets with flashlights.
Police searched everywhere, but they never found him.
No gas was ever proven, and no man was ever caught.
Experts later blamed fear, spreading through the town like a rumour.
Was he real, or just a fear that spread?
title: The Phantom Gasser Who Terrorized a Whole Town #shorts
description:
In September 1944, a whole Illinois town claimed a mysterious figure was gassing homes at night. Police never found him. Was it real, or fear spreading?
